## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Stops an assist that was started by the [Start Assist](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bassist) Action.

## Snippet

```
Stop Assist(Last Assist ID);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Assist ID_==

> ==**Assist ID**==
> _Type: **AssistId**, Default: **[Last Assist ID](/wiki/articles/last+assist+id)**_
> Specifies which assist instance to stop. This ID may be Last Assist ID or a Variable into which Last Assist ID was earlier stored.
````
